example_1_en: Capacitive reactance is the opposition of a capacitor to alternating current.
example_1_zh: 容抗是電容器對交流電所呈現的阻礙。
example_2_en: Capacitive reactance is dependent on frequency and capacitance.
example_2_zh: 容抗取決於頻率與電容量。

example_1_en: Inductive reactance is the opposition of an inductor to alternating current.
example_1_zh: 感抗是電感器對交流電所呈現的阻礙。
example_2_en: Inductive reactance is greater when frequency or inductance increases.
example_2_zh: 當頻率或電感增加時，感抗會變大。

example_1_en: Conductance is the reciprocal of electrical resistance.
example_2_zh: 電導以西門子為單位表示。

example_1_en: Surface resistance is measured along the surface of a material.
example_1_zh: 表面電阻是沿材料表面量測的電阻。
example_2_en: Surface resistance is important when evaluating static-charge dissipation.
example_2_zh: 評估靜電荷消散時，表面電阻很重要。

example_1_en: Bulk resistivity is an intrinsic electrical property of a material.
example_1_zh: 體積電阻率是材料本身的電氣特性。
example_2_en: Bulk resistivity is used to compare conductive and insulating materials.
example_2_zh: 體積電阻率用於比較導電與絕緣材料。

example_1_en: Electrostatic charge is an imbalance of electric charge on an item.
example_1_zh: 靜電荷是物件上電荷不平衡的狀態。
example_2_en: Electrostatic charge is dissipated through a suitable bonding path.
example_2_zh: 靜電荷會經由適當的接合路徑消散。

example_1_en: The copper layer acts as a local reference plane.
example_1_zh: 銅層可作為局部參考平面。
example_2_en: All critical shields should return to the reference plane.
example_2_zh: 所有關鍵屏蔽都應回到參考平面。
